scope: Test-only native benchmark controls, replacing the reserved NVPROBE.EXE slot in a matched diagnostic snapshot.
liveExport: NV_TOOLS_LIVE_ARTIFACTS=NVUI.TXT; bounded root filenames, at most 32 files, each at most 1 MiB; copies only changed contents.
actions: /list enumerates actual visible benchmark HWNDs and child control IDs/classes/style/check/text.
/click requires an existing visible enabled Button owned through its parent/owner chain by a 3DMark window. Manual checkboxes use the normal parent BN_CLICKED handler.
/text requires an existing visible enabled Edit in that benchmark and uses WM_SETTEXT.

nativeValidation.selected: Clear -> Image Quality -> original dialog count 2 of 22; main summary has only IQ Yes (2 of 2).
nativeValidation.result: Original IQ-only completion N/A, expected without game tests.
nativeValidation.savedProject: NVCIQ; Save IQ checkbox already checked; native Edit text and Save action verified by resulting project title.
nativeValidation.longHandler: Original Benchmark and Save Project modal handlers can outlive SendMessageTimeout. A timeout does not imply that the click was rejected; inspect visible state before retrying. Current source prints this explicitly.

limits: HWND values are observations from one guest lifetime; inspect again after reload or window recreation.
No graphics API, driver, benchmark EXE/DLL or saved results are patched.
These controls automate native UI; they do not establish image correctness or benchmark performance.
